prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1134; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a side impact collision at an intersection. Insured reports the other vehicle entered on the insured's driver side against a signal. Police report requested. Liability not yet confirmed.

Entry 2: Claimant reports back strain following the collision and is now represented by counsel. All further contact to go through the attorney's office. Medical authorization forms sent to counsel for signature.

Entry 3: Spoke with claimant's attorney. Confirmed claimant treated at urgent care and was referred for physical therapy. Requested itemized medical bills and treatment notes. Reviewing vehicle damage photos against the reported point of impact.

Entry 4: Received police report. Citing officer documents the claimant's vehicle as the one that failed to yield. Preliminary liability assessment leans toward shared fault pending witness statement. Witness contacted, statement scheduled.

Entry 5: Attorney submitted demand package including medical records and treatment summary for back strain. Demand under review. Reserve adjusted to reflect injury claim and property damage. Referred file to supervisor for settlement authority review.
